stem.text: The antibiotic tetracycline binds to the small subunit of bacterial ribosomes, stopping protein synthesis.
Bacteria have become resistant to tetracycline due to the effect of mutations.
Which effect could produce resistance to tetracycline?

A.text: preventing tetracycline from binding to the bacterial cell wall

B.text: preventing tetracycline from entering the bacterial cell

D.text: preventing the production of tetracycline by ribosomes
